metadata.seoDescription: How Your Brand protects your data: certifications, controls and how to reach the security team.

content.text: Your Brand holds your data to the standard we would want for our own. This page is the short version: what we have been audited against, how the platform is protected, and how to reach the people responsible. Every section links to the detail.
Audited every year. Reports are shared under NDA from the compliance page.

attrs.title: Encryption
attrs.description: TLS 1.2+ in transit and AES-256 at rest, with keys rotated automatically.

attrs.title: Access control
attrs.description: Single sign-on, hardware keys and least-privilege roles for every employee.

attrs.title: Infrastructure
attrs.description: Isolated networks, hardened images and infrastructure defined in reviewed code.

attrs.title: Monitoring
attrs.description: Centralised logs, alerting around the clock and an on-call security rotation.

attrs.title: Business continuity
attrs.description: Backups every hour, tested restores and a recovery plan we rehearse.

attrs.title: Vendor management
attrs.description: Every subprocessor is reviewed before use and every year after.

content.text: In the region you choose when you sign up — the EU or the US. It does not leave that region except through subprocessors listed on the subprocessors page.

attrs.title: Can I get your SOC 2 report?

content.text: Yes. Request it from the compliance page; we share it under a mutual NDA, usually within two business days.

attrs.title: Do you train models on customer data?

content.text: No. Customer content is never used to train models, ours or anyone else’s.

attrs.title: How do you handle a security incident?

content.text: We follow a written response plan, tell affected customers without undue delay and within 72 hours, and publish a write-up when it is over.

attrs.title: Do you have a bug bounty?

content.text: We run a disclosure programme with rewards for valid reports. See the vulnerability reports page for scope and how to submit.
Have a question we did not answer?
Our security team reads every message. For a suspected vulnerability, use the report form so it reaches the on-call engineer.

metadata.seoDescription: Encryption, access control, infrastructure, development, monitoring and continuity at Your Brand.

content.text: The controls behind the summary on the overview, grouped the way an auditor would read them.

All traffic is encrypted with TLS 1.2 or later, with HSTS on every domain. Data at rest — databases, backups and file storage — is encrypted with AES-256. Keys live in a managed key service and rotate automatically.
Single sign-on with hardware security keys for every employee
Production access is just-in-time, approved and logged
Access is reviewed every quarter and removed the day someone leaves
Workloads run in isolated networks with no inbound access except through the load balancer. Infrastructure is defined in code, reviewed like any other change and rebuilt from hardened images.
Every change is reviewed by a second engineer
Dependencies are scanned on every build and patched on a published schedule
Annual secure-coding training for everyone who ships code
Logs from every service are centralised and kept for a year. Alerts page an on-call engineer at any hour. Incidents follow a written plan, and every one ends with a review that is shared internally.
Databases are backed up hourly and copied to a second region. Restores are tested every month; the recovery plan is rehearsed twice a year.

metadata.seoDescription: SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, GDPR, HIPAA and CSA STAR — scope, dates and how to request reports.

content.text: Independent auditors check our controls every year. Reports are available to customers and prospects under NDA.
Ask your account contact, or write from the security contact page with your company name. We send reports under a mutual NDA, usually within two business days.

metadata.seoDescription: What Your Brand collects, where it is stored, your rights and how long it is kept.

content.text: How we handle personal data, in plain words. The legal text lives in our privacy policy and data processing agreement.
Account details you give us, the content you create, and usage data we need to run and improve the service. Nothing else.
In the region you choose — the EU or the US. Backups stay in that region.
See, export or delete your data from the account settings
Ask us to correct or restrict processing
Reach our data protection officer from the security contact page
Content is kept while your account is active and deleted within 30 days of closing it; backups age out within a further 35 days.

metadata.seoDescription: The companies that process customer data on behalf of Your Brand.

content.text: The companies that process customer data on our behalf. We give 30 days’ notice before adding one.
Subscribe from your account settings to receive an email when this list changes.

metadata.seoDescription: How to report a security issue to Your Brand, and what happens next.

content.text: If you believe you have found a security issue in Your Brand, please tell us. We will not take legal action against good-faith research.
Describe the issue and how to reproduce it
Include the URLs, accounts or requests involved
Give us reasonable time to fix it before you share it
We confirm we have your report and who is handling it.
We tell you whether we can reproduce it and how severe we think it is.
We let you know, credit you if you would like, and pay a reward for valid reports in scope.
In scope: the Your Brand web app, API and public website. Out of scope: denial of service, social engineering, and reports from automated scanners without a working proof.
